Revenue checks out: once you count refunded payments correctly, orders match actual money collected to within 1-5% (not the 20-40% gap it looked like at first).
Refunds are real and not lost or double-counted, but most (85%) land ~3 weeks after the original payout already went out, so we currently can't point to exactly which payout absorbed a given refund.

"How many customers do we have" depends entirely on definition: 11,258 total accounts, but only 6,159 bought in the last 12 months and just 411 have an active subscription — we recommend standardizing on the 6,159 figure as "active customers."
